name: Gentle Back Stretch
description: A relaxed forward curl and long breath while seated.

steps.title: Hands on your thighs
steps.text: Sit tall with your feet flat and your hands resting on your thighs.

steps.title: Round forward
steps.text: As you breathe out, let your back curl forward gently, only as far as feels comfortable.

steps.title: Lengthen
steps.text: As you breathe in, slowly sit tall again. Repeat a few times.

steps.title: Optional easy twist
steps.text: Turn your upper body slightly to look over one shoulder, then the other. Keep it small. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
